messages:
maya: heads-up: proposal to switch console quota storage to a compact envelope + summary index to cut reads and storage. looking for quick signoff for a PR.
devin: link to schema?
maya: analytics.quota_envelope(route_id, window_start, summary_jsonb, payload_jsonb) + quota_index(route_id, window_start, allowed, used)
samir: enforcement path must be fast. index sounds fine if kept synced during migration
maya: dual-write plan: api writes legacy timeseries + envelope; compactor validates checksum and deletes old rows incrementally.
devin: backfill strategy? full rewrite is risky
maya: incremental sharded backfill with route fingerprinting and bloom pre-pass to rewrite only changed routes
ops-bot: scheduled job: quota-envelope-backfill/shard-0 -> 2026-06-10T03:00:00Z
samir: monitoring: emit quota_migration.diff_rate and quota_api.read_latency.*; set 0.5% divergence alert
maya: canary: 0.5% routes 24h, 5% 48h, then ramp. admin banner + opt-out for enterprise. rollback: pause compactor, rehydrate from migration_audit.
devin: +1 infra, watch DB iops
samir: +1 analytics, add projection tests for billing pipeline
maya: i'll open PR tonight with checklist and gates.
